details.description: Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct is a 7-billion-parameter vision-language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released August 2024, built for instruction-following image and video understanding. It handles images at arbitrary resolutions via dynamic token mapping, processes videos over 20 minutes long, and is documented as a visual agent capable of operating mobile devices and robots. Hugging Face's model card lists Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct as a newer version of this exact model.
advantages: Scores 94.5 on DocVQA, a document visual-question-answering benchmark (Hugging Face model card).
Scores 84.3 on TextVQA (Hugging Face model card).
Scores 58.2 on MathVista (Hugging Face model card).
Scores 63.3 without subtitles and 69.0 with subtitles on Video-MME, a long-video understanding benchmark (Hugging Face model card).
Documented agent capability to operate mobile devices and robots through visual reasoning (Hugging Face model card).
disadvantages: Superseded by Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which Hugging Face's model card lists as a newer version of this model.
use_cases: Video question answering over long videos
Visual agent workflows operating mobile device or robot interfaces

notes: Catalog facts list only text_input/text_output modality and a 32,768-token max input/output for this URI (fireworks_ai-embedding-models), while Qwen's own model card describes Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct as an image- and video-input vision-language model; kept the catalog's facts per instructions and flag the modality mismatch here. The model's config.json lists max_position_embeddings as 32,768, matching the catalog's figure exactly, so context length is not actually in conflict. Corrected the release date from September to August 2024: Qwen's own blog post announcing Qwen2-VL-2B and -7B is dated August 29, 2024, and the Hugging Face repo was created August 28, 2024. Language support is described on the model card only as 'English, Chinese, most European languages, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Vietnamese, etc.' with no complete list or count, so languages was left empty.
